name: Progressive Volume Distillation with Active Learning
aliases: PVD-AL (Progressive Volume Distillation with Active Learning)
definition: A method for mutual conversion between different NeRF architectures (implicit, explicit, hybrid) using a unified two-level view and active learning strategies to accelerate distillation and improve synthesis quality.
summary: Progressive Volume Distillation with Active Learning converts NeRF architectures by splitting models into cascaded modules and dynamically selecting hard examples to accelerate distillation and improve quality.
